svg.title: Foundation · Shadows — hover each secondary and primary button state, then the focus ring

g.text: . Inset shadows create button borders without causing layout
shift on state changes. The outset focus ring layers on top, so both coexist without conflicts.
occupies layout space — toggling it on state change shifts surrounding content.
Inset box-shadow is painted inside the element bounds and causes zero layout shift, making state transitions smooth.
White background · #303030 text · inset shadow border
Bottom shadow darker (#b5b5b5) → visible bottom edge. Side/top lighter (#e3e3e3) → subtle framing.
All shadow values lighter — border recedes slightly on hover.
Top-inset shadow replaces bottom — creates "pressed in" visual. Darks darken.
Rest shadow + outset focus ring. Both coexist without conflicting border declarations.
No shadow. bg-disabled + text-disabled tokens. cursor: not-allowed.
White inner highlights on top/sides (20% opacity). Black inner stroke on all edges for definition.
Primary shadow + outset focus ring stacked.
